name: Chateau DIY
description: Adventurous British families buy and renovate beautiful chateaux in France.

videos.title: Christmas: Episode 1
videos.overview: At Château du Doux, Abbie, Clive and Karen look forward to downing tools for Christmas, before a visit from the fire safety inspector to check their outdoor terrace.

videos.title: Christmas: Episode 2
videos.overview: A national timber shortage threatens to scupper Stephanie's plans to decorate the Marquis salon at Château de Lalande with expensive wallpaper in time for a Christmas party. In the Dordogne, Abbie, Clive and Karen erect a heavy spiral staircase and install complicated lighting on the terrace roof and at Château Mareuil in the Nouvelle Acquitane, Belinda and Lee try to bring an air of mystery to a unique Christmas party for their neighbours.

videos.title: Christmas: Episode 3
videos.overview: Matt takes to the cherry picker to decorate the 40-feet tree in the garden of Château La Briance. Ben and Billie begin the overhaul of their wine cave, hoping it will be ready for a Christmas toast.

videos.title: Christmas: Episode 4
videos.overview: In the Cognac region, Sarah creates large decorations the big chateau needs to make a festive statement, while George struggles with the weight of the tree. Near Bordeaux, Edward hopes his renovation of the chateau bell will convince his son that Santa will really visit this year.

videos.title: Christmas 2022: Episode 1
videos.overview: In Cognac country at Château de Brives, Sarah and George have their work cut out as they organise a traditional English carol concert in their French village church.

videos.title: Christmas 2022: Episode 2
videos.overview: The chateau owners embark on some creative projects to prepare for the festive season including flying sleigh decorations, mantlepiece ornaments and lodge restorations. Zion scales new heights to unblock the chimney, and Ben and Billy finally finish their stable project.

videos.title: Christmas 2022: Episode 3
videos.overview: The chateau owners decorate for Christmas. Julia looks for historically accurate decorations while Trish tries to find eco-friendly decor that fit with her Bostonian roots. Alison and Zion are nearly finished renovating their hunting lodge, but with it being 8 metres tall, decorating is proving difficult.

videos.title: Christmas 2022: Episode 4
videos.overview: In the Dordogne, chef Tim wants to cook a traditional French feast, and while Krys makes decorations, he puts plans in place to roast the goose over an open fire. Meanwhile, at Château de la Ruche, Rebecca goes all out to prepare the chateau for Christmas with decorations and sweet delights, although Tim is feeling far from festive. Narrated by Adjoa Andoh.

videos.title: Christmas 2022: Episode 5
videos.overview: Donna and Paul have their work cut out repairing a grand staircase in their grounds in time to host a festive drinks event with a twist. Near the north coast, Chris and Jolyon's large family party is upon them, and as Christmas decorating gets underway, they go the extra mile by creating a hidden Santa's grotto for the kids. Meanwhile, at Château de Lalande, Stephanie and Gerry get the new Marquis Salon dressed for a Christmas dinner. Narrated by Adjoa Andoh.

videos.title: Christmas 2023: Episode 1
videos.overview: There's a festive frenzy in the Loire Valley, as Ben and Billie embark on an ambitious project to create the tallest Christmas tree in France. Meanwhile, Philip prepares the château for an unforgettable Christmas extravaganza, along with a surprise DIY project for when Janet returns.

videos.title: Christmas 2023: Episode 2
videos.overview: At Janet and Philip's chateau, they try to complete their hallway transformation before their Christmas extravaganza. It's also all hands on deck at Chateau de Dohem for Wendy and Marcus, as they prepare for their first-ever Christmas-themed murder mystery party. At Chateau de Lalacelle, Terry and Ashley make their own snow indoors by bringing down one of the chateau ceilings, before they can switch on their 5000 lights to start Christmas properly.

videos.title: Chrismast 2023: Episode 3
videos.overview: At Chateau du Puits es Pratx, Tim and Sasha prepare for the final wedding of the season. A couple who married there 10 years ago are returning with their children for a Christmas they'll never forget. At Chateau des Vieilles Vignes, Nick and Nicole are planning a Christmas party but they don't have a floor. With concrete waiting to harden, there's just 24 hours before the party begins. Meanwhile, in the Dordogne, Tim and Krys have big plans for an unforgettable treat for Tim's son Owen, while also creating the perfect hot chocolate.

videos.title: Christmas 2023: Episode 4
videos.overview: Before their annual Christmas soirée at Château Trois Cloches, Chris and Jolyon plan to transform their hallway. They'll need to work harder than Santa's elves to pull this off. At Château du Puits es Pratx, it's the day of the big wedding. However, with flowers, food and photographs to organise, there's lots to do before Tim and Sasha can say 'I do'.

videos.title: Christmas 2023: Episode 5
videos.overview: Near Le Havre, Chris and Jolyon are as busy as two elves at Château Trois Cloches, trying to finish their hallway before their annual Christmas soirée with friends and family. Donna and Paul are going deep underground as they hold their Christmas get-together in the château caves. Over in Montmorillon, Belinda and Lee are spreading plenty of holiday cheer, as they serve up an incredible dinner to 60 guests and go chestnut hunting in search of the true taste and smell of Christmas.

videos.title: Christmas 2024: Episode 1
videos.overview: At Château de la Boutinière, Alison and Zion desperately try to renovate an ensuite bedroom, while at Château de Lalande, Stephanie bake Christmas wellington for 15.

videos.title: Christmas 2024: Episode 2
videos.overview: At Chateau de la Boutiniere, Alison and Zion are hoping to complete an ensuite before Christmas and in the Pyrenees, Trish prepares for her first culinary workshop with a Michelin-starred chef. Jon and Carmen hold a festive medieval banquet.

videos.title: Christmas 2024: Episode 3
videos.overview: Sarah and George host a festive day of fun at Chateau De Brives and Chris and Jolyon have problems completing their pond when a van gets stuck in their garden. Belinda and Lee host their annual festive fundraiser for a local cat charity at Chateau Mareuil.

videos.title: Christmas 2024: Episode 4
videos.overview: In the Dordogne, Tim and Krys spread festive joy by hosting a gingerbread chateau competition. In Normandy, there's no room at the inn for Auntie Paula at Château de Lalacelle, so in the spirt of Christmas, Terry and Ashley transform a stable block into her new home. Meanwhile, in the Nouvelle-Aquitaine at La Grande Maison La Pinelle, Bart and Sarah are going crackers as they want to hold a Christmas extravaganza for 60 guests in their barn.

videos.title: Christmas 2024: Episode 5
videos.overview: At the picturesque Château de la Fare, Janet and Philip have noticed that their hallway is looking tired, so decide to re-deck the halls before family arrive. Further north in the Charente-Maritime, there's a Christmas miracle as Bart and Sarah hold their big extravaganza. Narrated by Adjoa Andoh.

videos.title: Christmas 2025: Episode 1
videos.overview: Alison and Zion transform Château de la Boutinière into a giant advent calendar, while at Chateau de Cézérac, Jon and Carmen work against the clock to finish a bedroom before Santa arrives. At Château Chomet, Debbie and Dave throw their first ever Christmas bash; what could possibly go wrong?

videos.title: Christmas 2025: Episode 2
videos.overview: Jon and Carmen rush to get a bedroom ready for a Christmas bash at Château de Cézérac, while a carol concert at Château de la Fare is jeopardised by a blocked chimney. Over at Château de la Grillère, Tim and Sharon are having trouble fitting their 12-metre tree beneath their three-metre ceiling.

videos.title: Christmas 2025: Episode 3
videos.overview: Tim and Krys give the staircase of their Dordogne chateau a medieval makeover. Lily and Luke plan a new year celebration full of surprises at Château du Puits es Pratx in Languedoc.

videos.title: Christmas 2025: Episode 4
videos.overview: In the Dordogne at Château des Vieilles Vignes, Nick and Nicole are in a festive frenzy, racing to finish their grand dining room before guests arrive for a glittering Christmas celebration. Over at Château de Pican, Jane and Rory are busy making room in the stables for a very special new arrival. And in the heart of France at Château de Lalande, Stephanie is determined to unveil her beautifully restored chapel before Christmas, while Ashley and Terry treat their nephew Jonathan to a chocolate-filled festive adventure.

videos.title: Christmas 2025: Episode 5
videos.overview: In the heart of France at Château de Lalande, it's opening day for Stephanie and her beautifully restored chapel, but with rain pouring down, she'll need a Christmas miracle to keep spirits high. Over in the Loire Valley, Ben and Billie are serving up a Christmas Eve fish feast with plenty of festive sparkle at Château La Grande Maison. And in Brittany at Moulin du Couesnon, Donna and Paul are lighting up their grand old property and spreading Christmas cheer with hard hats, fairy lights and all!

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Edward starts an ambitious project to convert caves into a wine venue, but Anna isn't convinced it'll be worth it. Jayne and Steve plan a plunge pool but Steve doesn't read the instructions.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Edward is re-building the pool house, closely supervised by Anna. Debbie and Nigel move their bedroom into an unrenovated cellar. Jayne and Steve go all out on a Renaissance theme.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Anna and Edward's ambitious caves project comes to fruition. Lee goes metal-detecting. Julia renovates her guardian's cottage into a gîte.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Lydia and Gary start their search for a chateau to call home. Ben and Billie begin a complicated honeymoon suite project. Anna and Edward host their first wedding of the year.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Ben and Billie have a tricky task on their hands as they push to install the jacuzzi bath in the honeymoon suite's bathroom. Ben and Vanessa breath new life into their very own ballroom with gold leaf and a hand-painted ceiling fresco, complete with paintings of their children. Meanwhile, at Chateau La Perriere, Karen has lots to learn as she takes over the reins from the caretakers.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: New chateau owners Helen and Matt create a homage to Napoleon and a mural based on Caravaggio's painting of Cupid. Tim and Rebecca finish the first floor of their gîte renovation.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Helen and Matt create an armoury in one of their towers - and build two cannons to guard their chateau. Donna and Paul start work on demolishing a wall and removing a staircase.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: At Château la Briance, DIY novices Helen and Matt create an elaborate ceiling for their bridal suite and have to hoist the four-poster bed in through a window.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: It's a big day at Chateau la Briance, as Helen and Matt get ready to finally open their chateau to guests on Valentine's Day. After weeks of hard work, Donna and Paul have to be creative with their cornicing as they finally complete their guest salon.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Anna and Philipp discover some unwanted wildlife in their chimney and finally move into the renovated top floor apartment of the chateau. Donna and Paul start work on their Victoria Suite and its lush en-suite bathroom. However, Paul's not so sure about the decor.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Angela and Steve try to create a toilet in one of their turrets by upcycling a champagne bowl into a basin. Wendy and Marcus come unstuck with an attic conversion.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Angela and Steve continue to renovate their Monet suite, but the decision to install a bathroom in the bedroom leads to further problems. Amy and Marc start to reinstate a medieval well in the garden at Château Les Rosieres, and Alison and Zion visit a derelict place that has lain abandoned for years.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: In the Loire Valley, Stephanie and her friend Gerry embark on a flamboyant makeover of the entrance hall, using 4,000 euro wallpaper. Donna and Paul host a tour de France event.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: At Chateau de Lalande, Stephanie and Gerry go bold with a colourful project in the tower staircase that Stephanie wants to turn in to a pigeonniere - a place to keep pigeons. In cognac country, Sarah and George are under pressure renovating a bedroom in time for a wedding in just a week's time. Cameras also return to Chateau de la Ruche, where Tim and Rebecca's gite conversion has moved on to the next stage.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Tim and Krys embark on a massive, exciting new venture as they leave their old chateau and start work on an abandoned and forgotten building that had been taken over by squatters. Tim and Sasha try to create a winding `path of discovery" through their massive bamboo forest to reveal a hidden view.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Matt and Helen introduce a touch of the UK with an English bandstand - only to find it has arrived as a flatpack. Ben and Billie begin renovating their 19th-century ballroom.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Matt and Helen hope to attract wedding parties by converting their orangery into a reception venue, putting pressure on Matt's DIY skills. Sarah and George begin to convert their cellars into a tasting venue and even find time to learn some cocktail making tips at a local distillery, while Ben and Billie's ballroom restoration gets under way.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Sarah and George complete their cellar conversion and make a discovery in one of the old barrels. Tim and Krys finally move into their new chateau and get to work on the garden.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Philipp starts a colossal ongoing project to reinstate their formal garden, and despite Anna's concerns, he gets chainsaw-happy with some unexpected consequences.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Incredibly wet weather has meant delays for Julia's swimming pool project, but she cracks on with finishing the renovation of the barn into a wedding and events space.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Donna and Paul discover their floorboards are riddled with termites, while Clive takes the opportunity to teach his daughter some DIY skills while putting together a bridal salon.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Abbie, Clive and Karen decide to convert a disused outbuilding into state-of-the-art function rooms. Donna has ambitious plans to turn an old sideboard into a grand statement bed.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Angela and Steve set out to convert the old wine store into a wedding space, and after two years of hard work, Tim and Rebecca finally complete the first room of their gîte.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Angela and Steve's wine store conversion gets even more challenging, as planning permission means they must create a stone arch for the three-metre-high new doorway that matches the other doors at the chateau. Abbie, Clive and Karen get inventive with the bar area in their function rooms and their top-of-the-range LED dance floor arrives, while Edward faces his fears as he attempts to fell a 100ft oak tree that is threatening to damage the building.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: As Angela and Steve come to the end of their wine store conversion, they get inventive to safely install the heavy three-metre-high double doors and have some creative ideas for the interior. Arguments bubble as the finish line comes into sight for Abbie, Clive and Karen's function rooms. Near Bordeaux, Edward tries to help Anna learn new DIY skills as they try to make glossy entrance signs for their chateau.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Debbie and Nigel think creatively when it comes to fixing a wonky fireplace. In the far south, Sasha creates a xeriscape garden with her daughter, Lily, while Tim embarks on a challenging and unusual project to build a vast tunnel to provide shade for flowers entirely out of bamboo.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Belinda and Lee clash over the lighting for their gallery space, Tim gets creative with Sasha's bamboo tunnel and Stephanie plans to transform a fishing pond into a swimming pool.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The discovery of an old postcard inspires Janet and Philip to rebuild a lost turret. Donna and Paul think laterally when they decide to reinstate a statement window.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Questions are raised in the south of France when mortar refuses to set during Janet and Philip's ambitious turret project. At Chateau Lagorce, Anna and Edward hope to make the dream of their six-year-old son Charles a reality when they try to build a tree house on a grand scale. Plus, Ben and Billie's ballroom restoration project reaches the decoration stage - meaning Billie must face to her fear of heights to paint the ceiling.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: It's a huge day at Chateau de la Fare when Janet and Philip's new turret is finally ready to have its spire installed. The pressure builds in the run-up to the reveal event where they've invited the local mayor. Having struggled with months of delays caused by the winter floods, Julia's new pool is nearing completion and she's determined to bring her artistic talents to the project.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Tim and Rebecca are coming to the end of their two-year gîte project, while Tim and Krys press on with their formal garden and tennis court restoration.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Tim and Krys must complete their formal garden at Domaine de la Barde in time for a party, and tensions are high when they try to install the grand central fountain.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In Northern France, Tim and Margreeth decide to create a well-being and mindfulness experience in their vast woodland, starting with a sensory `barefoot path". The job turns out to be less than zen. Matt and Helen take on the restoration of a horse-drawn carriage and Helen faces the challenge of upholstery. At Château de la Fare, Janet is back from the UK and keen to help Philip finish their third guest suite. However, something as simple as the paint colour causes concern.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: At Château des Lys, Tim and Margreeth continue with their woodland mindfulness project as they plan to add a yoga area under an ancient linden tree. However, rain threatens Tim's grand plan to build a log sweat lodge. In the Dordogne region of France, Abbie, Clive and Karen juggle DIY and the raspberry harvest to get ready for wedding season.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In Picardie in northern France, Ithaca and Alex start to prepare for their annual fundraising brocante and flower fair. However, despite meticulous planning, the rain threatens boggy ground and a total washout. Tim and Margeeth try to turn an old stable into a cheese and wine-tasting venue and must learn some new skills along the way. New owners Alison and Zion make a start on repairs to their long-abandoned 19th-century château, but even with an 18-metre cherry picker, some jobs prove too tricky.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: At Château Lagorce, Edward rebuilds some rotten shutters that feature prominently in wedding photographs. May and Guy lock horns over the future of their now rotten chicken coop.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Becky and Mark begin another guest room in preparation for their family visit, but face issues with a cracked wall. Edward creates a private terrace as a surprise for Anna.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Amy and Marc learn new skills to make their own wine, while Edward plans to build a hi-tech chicken coop - only for his feathered friends to give him the runaround.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Amy and Marc receive an award for their renovations and host a picnic in their garden for 60 of the organisation's members. However, the garden is criss-crossed by open trenches for all their ongoing plumbing and electrical work. Becky and Mark are under pressure to complete their final guest room, but they still find time to introduce their daughters to two new kittens. In north-west France, Philip and Angelina are flat-out preparing for the event season. The moat must be navigated to smarten up the château's enormous shutters and Angelina makes over a kilometre of bunting.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Amy and Marc have a mountain to climb in the garden ahead of the picnic and also need to make their dining room into a showpiece for the event. When the bridge connecting them to the mainland starts to crumble, Philip and Angelina are forced to take action. Belinda and Lee start an adventurous project turning an outbuilding into a two-bedroom gîte.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: With a first booking on the cards, Ben and Billie must finish renovating their ballroom, but a delay in the delivery of five two-metre-tall mirrors may scupper their chances.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Anna and Edward host their first wedding of the season, but with no chef, Edward has to cater the event. Emma and Paul start work on their al fresco bar and dining area.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Debbie and Nigel create a new terrace for their hot tub, but taking on all the work themselves is no simple task, especially when it comes to moving the bath into position.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Living in a chateau is a constant battle with maintenance, and for Erin and JB it's no exception as they try to combat a leaky roof. Erin also has a creative art project to enhance their Yellow Salon for an anniversary dinner party. In Cognac Country, Sarah and George take on the challenge to makeover an entire estate cottage on a tiny budget, wanting to create a family bolthole for the busy wedding season.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Storms and bad weather have spelt disaster for Erin and JB, as part of the original mediaeval foundations of their island have collapsed into the moat. Trying to fix it all themselves, JB's engineering skills are put to the test when they try to raise the heavy stones. Stephanie's tartan apartment project for Gerry continues as she rolls up her sleeves to sand blast the hayloft beams. Sarah and George agree to host the local town fete, but with a septic tank being installed just days before the event the grounds are far from picture perfect.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: At Château de la Fare, Janet and Philip overhaul their entrance gates for something grander. Elsewhere, Matt has a theatrical idea to transform a cellar into a quirky dungeon.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: At Château de la Boutinière, it's Zion's 60th birthday, but a power failure threatens everything. In the Loire Valley, Ben and Billie start an ambitious renovation project.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In the Loire Valley, Ben has to wallpaper for the very first time. Meanwhile, Julia converts her former artist's studio into living accommodation at her woodland chateau.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In the Dordogne, Abbie, Clive, Karen and Ross start a complicated project to create a terrace dining area. Meanwhile, Ben constructs a soundproof door in the Loire Valley.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: At Château du Doux, bad weather threatens to derail a wedding. Ben has his work cut out with a chandelier light fixture. And Billie attempts to paint new life into old furniture.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Philip and Janet push to complete a guest suite with creative upcycling and clever sewing. Tim and Krys turn their attention to the interior of their long-neglected chateau.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Tim struggles to get a huge olive tree into position without destroying Sasha's flower beds. Christina and Sassan explore their new chateau. Tim and Krys work on their kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Alison and Zion bicker while moving an old polytunnel. Tim and Sasha get inventive creating a sumptuous bridal suite, and the Cherry family start a large-scale kitchen project.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Sarah adds opulent floristry to her repertoire, while George scales new heights to wash the chateau. Elsewhere, Nigel keeps his hand on the purse strings of Debbie's gravel garden.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Stephanie and Gerry bid to complete their opulent Marquis Salon restoration. Anna and Edward face floods, while Sarah and George trial an exciting new money-making venture.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: An unusual WWII-style renovation in their attic has Emma and Paul at loggerheads. Ben and Billie battle the heat to finish their garden apartment.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Jayne and Steve are pulled from pillar to post as they host a painting course. Chateau shopper Sarah is smitten with period features, but Bart worries about the level of DIY.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Trish calls in friends to help bring light into the dark interior of her medieval chateau. Edward and Anna struggle to revamp an overgrown border.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: In a bid to protect her solar panels from the sheep, Trish builds a fence. Sarah shows off her new wedding floristry skills, while Edward tackles a tricky engineering project.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Julia battles the heat as she prepares to host her first wedding. Alison and Zion start a long-term garden project, but hidden rocks may end it before it's begun.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: At Château Lagorce, Edward must learn to roof tile for a poolside project. Ben and Vanessa start transforming an old laundry into a cinema and games room.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Ben and Vanessa rush to finish their new gin bar, housed in an old garage. Having discovered discarded oak boards in the chicken shed, Ben's DIY skills come in handy.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Matt and Helen brace themselves to host their first ever wedding at Château La Briance. Tensions rise for Belinda and Lee as they try to install the kitchen in their two-bed gîte.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: In the Loire Valley, Guy struggles to build a flatpack spiral staircase, while May spots some safety issues that have to be addressed before her yoga retreat can commence.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: In the Dordogne, Nick gets demolition happy in a bid to open up the entrance hall of his derelict chateau. And it's a big day for Becky and Mark as their new gîte floor is laid.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Sasha struggles to understand Tim's idea for an ingenious bamboo water feature. Elsewhere, Wendy and Marcus work hard to throw a chateau-sized birthday bash!

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: At Château du Doux, the family face a challenge turning a storage room into an accessible bedroom. Emotions run high for Christina and Sassan as they tackle their pool project.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: At Château du Puits es Pratx, Tim and Sasha battle soaring temperatures to host a wedding and Sasha must get the floristry looking its best.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: At Château de la Fare, Janet and Philip start their biggest challenge yet - the creation of their largest guest suite, part of which will be in the medieval tower Over at Château de la Boutinière, Alison and Zion press to complete their first ever gite, and with a booking on the cards, the pressure is on to get it done in time

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: At Château Larribau, Paul and Julia enjoy their first week as chateau owners, and are keen to make the huge house feel like a home by renovating one room as a bolthole. At Château de Bourneau, Erin and JB are alarmed to discover that their dormer windows are falling apart, leading to water damage.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Ben and Billie embark on an ambitious project to turn their boatshed into an outdoor glamping kitchen. It's no mean feat, with concrete running low and plumbing to work out

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: A kitchen renovation is jeopardised by a nest of ants playing havoc with the electrics. A wedding anniversary allows a recently renovated ballroom to be used for the first time

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: The Cherry family start renovating their bridal suite, complete with turret bathroom, where a tricky tiling job tests Aaron and his dad Paul's patience

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Stephanie and Gerry start a personal project using her late father's paintings as wallpaper inspiration. They also have to learn new skills to make a large impact in the tiny space

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: New chateau owners Chris and Jolyon have bought Château Trois Cloches. It is a huge project but, eager to turn it into a home and events venue, the pair start work on a guest suite

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: At Chateau des Vieilles Vignes, Nick and Nicole battle freezing temperatures to transform a wing. And at Château la Grande Maison, Ben and Billie set out to create a luxurious suite.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Tim and Rebecca host their first-ever floral retreat. Nick and Nicole race against time to create a liveable space before their baby arrives.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Erin and JB tackle the tall order of turret renovation. Ben and Billie host a couples' weekend. Nick and Nicole take on their chateau's entire facade.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Erin and JB battle to weatherproof their turret. Ben and Billie renovate the gatehouse. Nick and Nicole race to complete renovations before baby arrives.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Belinda and Lee pull out all the stops for a three-course charity dinner. Erin and JB race to complete a towering renovation in their fairy-tale turret.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Tim and Sasha convert a 180-year-old wine barrel into a dining space. Andrea and David view a property that one of the three musketeers lived in.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Trish learns that building a curved bridge is not as straightforward as she thought. Will picky chateau shoppers Andrea and David find their dream home?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Terry and Ashley uncover a nasty surprise behind their derelict chateau's wood panelling. Belinda and Lee host a coronation-themed murder mystery.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Sarah and George transform two enormous barns into a nightclub and a lounge. In the Loire Valley, May and Guy race to renovate an uninviting terrace.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Terry and Ashley are up against a brick wall to revive their garden. Erin and JB welcome a different type of guest... at their biodiverse insect hotel.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: At Château Lagorce, Anna and Edward wrestle a huge tree before it brings a wall down. At Château Trois Cloches, Chris and Jolyon turn a pit into a pond.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Donna and Paul create a highlander-themed suite. Ben and Billie give their facade a facelift. And changing a chateau lightbulb can be a tall order.

videos.title: Episode 13

videos.title: Episode 20

videos.title: Episode 22

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: In the Lot Valley, Jon and Carmen play tug of war with vines threatening their tower. Christina and Sassan call for help with their poolside kitchenette.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Tim and Sasha overhaul an outdated bedroom. Christina and Sassan's kitchenette pushes them to the limit. Tim and Krys race to finish three bedrooms.

videos.overview: In Languedoc, bad weather threatens a wedding. Tim and Krys race to complete their cookery school. Christina and Sassan disagree over their kitchenette.

videos.overview: Trish makes a rotten discovery under her pool decking. Sarah and George open their doors to the village as they celebrate their chateau's centenary.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Anna and Edward juggle guest turnovers as they get the chateau wedding-ready. Janet and Philip bring the ceiling down in their ambitious room renovation.

videos.overview: Janet and Philip face a balancing act as their renovation starts to wobble. Clive finds cracks in his handywork as a septic tank starts to flood.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Having sold up at Château de Saugé, Donna and Paul start a new adventure and get to work on a dilapidated water mill in Normandy. And at Chateau de Cézérac, Jon and Carmen create their dream bathroom.

videos.overview: At Château de Bourneau, Erin and JB desperately rush to complete their turret art room renovations before local dignitaries arrive. In the Dordogne, Nick and Nicole begin major work on their chateau.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: At Château de Lalacelle, Terry and Ashley desperately try to complete their guest suite. New chateau owners Tim and Sharon have an unpleasant encounter in their tower bathroom suite.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Tim and Sasha create a bespoke wine store at Château du Puits Es Pratx. New chateau family the Hutsons get to work on their hallway. In Charente, Bart and Sarah tackle their damp problem.

videos.overview: In the glorious foothills of the Pyrenees, DIY novice Trish overhauls a guest bedroom. At Château Domaine De Le Barde in the Dordogne, chef Tim is busy crafting a unique, handmade barbeque.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The heat's on for Tim and Krys, who must finish their deluxe BBQ before guests arrive. Chris and Jolyon tackle their towering to-do list. Janet and Philip begin their most ambitious project to date.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Ben and Billie take on the tall order of transforming their hallway and stairs. Chris and Jolyon navigate uncharted waters to complete their nautical-themed dining room.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Nick and Nicole hope to create a little bit of magic with a Narnia-inspired secret doorway. Chateau shoppers Lucy and Tim begin their fairytale quest to find the perfect chateau.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Ben and Vanessa take plastering to new heights with their handmade ceiling frescos. And it's decision time for Lucy and Tim... which chateau will become their forever home?

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Jon and Carmen transform a disused, smoke-damaged kitchen into a medieval dining room. Alison and Zion crack on with their chateau's exterior, but can they get it wedding-ready?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Paul and Debbie attempt to complete their tower stairwell before guests arrive. Ben and Billie are determined to preserve part of their chateau's history: a 50-year-old wine barrel.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Tim and Sasha turn their front steps into a stunning feature for the wedding season. Can Nick and Nicole finish their new dining room in time for their son's first birthday party?

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Stephanie adds a touch of glamour to one of the busiest parts of her home. Belinda and Lee have a leaking roof... and a looming wedding. Jane and Rory move into their new chateau.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Tim and Krys make a splash with their pool renovation. Will Paul get crucial measurements right for the new window? Lee's broken his foot just as the first bride and groom of the season are due.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The heat is on as Terry and Ashley take out floorboards to fit a fireplace. Will Krys and Tim's final pool renovations go swimmingly? And Janet and Phillip tackle the tower suite.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Can Janet and Phillip meet the tall order of finishing their tower suite kitchen? Anna and Edward branch out into experience weekends. Alison and Zion's first wedding looms with loads still to do.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: It's wedding day for Alison and Zion, but with things still on the to-do list, will it all go without a hitch? Donna and Paul are keen to move into their gîte, but they need proper ceilings first!

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Jane and Rory are stumped by a large tree that's dangerously close to overhead cables. And Sharon and Tim dig deep as they prepare for the arrival of a 10-metre swimming pool.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Chris and Jolyon rush to complete a guest room renovation before their friends come to stay. And Paul and Debbie are feeling boxed in as they fit a square ensuite into a round turret room.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Tim and Krys want to revamp their abandoned orangery, but the weather has other ideas. The Hutsons take on a huge tree that's precariously close to an ancient greenhouse.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Tim and Krys desperately try to finish their abandoned orangery. Brothers Richard and Will are on the hunt for a magnificent chateau. Mark and Becky want to add a much-needed boot room to their home.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Donna and Paul are eager to complete the first habitable room in their water mill. And Terry and Ashley's entire chateau renovation is at risk when they discover water damage and rotten beams.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Preparations are underway for Stephanie and Philip's magnificent engagement party. Sharon and Tim plan to build a large pool house. Can Jon and Carmen save a smoke-damaged room?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Tim and Sasha create a special garden for happy couples to enjoy on their wedding day. And it's moving-in day for new chateau owners Debbie and Dave, but there's a problem...

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Anna and Edward hold their 400th wedding. Tim and Sasha are bamboozled as they try to create a bespoke bench. Terry and Ashley continue to transform their guest suite.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: The Huston family are determined to restore a beautiful ornate fountain that hasn't worked in years. And Chris and Jolyon have just the 60 shutters to renovate.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: In Nouvelle-Aquitaine, only the frogs are enjoying the swimming pool. And Tim and Krys have gardening tasks galore before they host their largest event ever.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Tim and Sasha are busy creating a complicated confetti drop for a wedding. And Jo and Carmen try to complete their tricky swimming pool renovation.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: It's moving-in day for Nick and Nicola but after two years of work, are they ready to settle in? And Terry and Ashley are trying to garden on a chateau scale.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: The local mayor is heading over to Château de Lalacelle for an open house event. And Sharon and Tim battle in a wallpaper-hanging competition in Haute-Vienne.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: At Château de la Boutinière, Alison and Zion race to restore a chapel that's lain untouched for 30 years in time for a couple's 60th anniversary celebrations. At Château de Montespieu, newbies Louisa and Roger take on a bold revival of their towering six-turreted home.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Donna and Paul race to finish a risky new floor, six metres up, in Brittany, while Terry and Ashley gamble on their most lavish suite yet at Château de Lalacelle. At Château de la Grillère, Sharon and Tim race against time to complete their tower suite.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In Normandy, Terry and Ashley race to finish the 401 Suite and re-hang a 200-crystal chandelier. At Château Mareuil, Belinda and Lee tackle mould in a tower. In the Loire Valley, Vivienne and Simon rush to finish a bathroom mural before Mum arrives.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Tim and Krys build a wine cave at Château Domaine De La Barde. Alicia and Carlton prepare for their first wedding at Chateau D'Aran, while Tim and Sasha create a bold, colourful courtyard at Chateau du Puits es Pratx.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Kathryn and Steve battle to revive their collapsing 14th-century kitchen at Château d'Azerat. At Château de Seguenville, Becky and Mark push hard to complete grandad George's gîte in time for his 80th birthday.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Kathryn and Steve battle to revive their 14th-century kitchen without losing the building's sense of history, while Sarah and George face their first wedding of the season.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: At Château de Pican, Jane and Rory struggle to fit straight skirting boards on centuries-old wonky bathroom floors during their huge gîte renovation. Near Cognac, Bart and Sarah race to turn their home into a fairytale wedding venue for their best friends' nuptials, and they're starting with a nightmare bathroom. In the Charente, new owners Sophie and Ray are determined to transform a boring bedroom into a beautiful boudoir.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: On the banks of the Lot river at Château de Cézérac, Jon and Carmen are giving their tired courtyard a full facelift. At Château de Lalacelle, everything hangs in the balance as Terry and Ashley race to complete their 401 suite restoration, but there are vast curtains and a brand-new front door still to install. Also, at Château de Pican, Jane and Rory must fully renovate their dilapidated gîte before summer.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: At Château de Lalacelle in Normandy, Terry and Ashley race to finish their opulent 401 suite, but there's still a daunting amount left to do with guests due imminently. Ben and Billie embark on a dramatic two-bedroom apartment makeover for a Valentine's Day event at Château La Grande Maison. In the Dordogne, Nick and Nicole battle to transform the façade of their dilapidated chateau into an architectural statement.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In the Loire Valley at Château La Grande Maison, Ben and Billie's unfinished apartment gets their hearts racing as try to complete it for a decadent Valentine's Day event. At the Château Trois Cloches, Chris and Jolyon are tackling a full façade transformation. Near Bordeaux at Château Méaume, Mark and Sandra juggle a full gîte renovation with managing a vineyard and tractor lessons.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Erin and JB race to light up their red salon before a drinks party. Anna and Edward rebuild a sweeping stairway, and Christina and Sassan transform their grand front gates.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Tim and Sasha race to transform their courtyard in time for impending back-to-back weddings. A crumbling roof threatens Anna and Edward's deluxe wine weekend, while Roger and Louisa desperately need a new en-suite.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: DIY novices Lionel and Claire tackle a luxury en-suite. Alison and Zion deal with gaping ceilings as they rebuild a top-floor apartment. Tim and Sasha prepare for not one but two huge weddings.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: In Brittany, Donna and Paul tackle the utility room of their five-floor crumbling home, but with Paul balancing on exposed beams above deep water, it's DIY with danger. In the rolling hills of central France at Château Chomet, Debbie and Dave chase their dream of launching a craft business, starting with a full barn overhaul that strips out everything from a kitchen sink to a towering iron staircase. And in the Dordogne at Château Domaine De La Barde, seasoned renovators Tim and Krys set out to revive a lifeless reception room by restoring centuries-old ceiling beams.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: In the Occitanie region, Janet and Philip set out to give their tired dining room a regal makeover, battling rotten skirting and a bespoke ceiling, but can they really create a space fit for royalty? In Brittany, Donna and Paul push on with their five-floor derelict home, working on precision tiling and custom skirting for their utility room. But have they taken on more than they can handle? And at Château de Lalande, Stephanie hunts for the perfect spot to build a chicken palace, hopefully without ruffling too many feathers.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: In Brittany, Donna and Paul race to finish their utility room, while in Normandy at Château de Lalacelle, Terry and Ashley turn their attention to the front gardens, with ambitious water features planned and kilometres of pipework to lay. Meanwhile in the Dordogne, moving day brings a startling discovery for Helen and Malcolm: a cellar packed with 20,000 bottles.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: At Château de Lalacelle in Normandy, Terry and Ashley are expecting more than 1,000 visitors, but their front garden still looks like a building site. At Château de la Boutinière, Alison and Zion attempt to create a top-floor apartment, but a floating ceiling and a dismantled fireplace threaten to derail their plans, while Kathryn and Steve race to finish a vast kitchen makeover in Château d'Azerat home before their son arrives.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: At Château de Montespieu, Louisa and Roger face their first wedding booking, but they need extra accommodation. Debbie and Dave transform their dusty disused barn into a craft retreat at Château Chomet, while at Château de la Boutinière, Alison and Zion battle mismatched windows, curtains and an upcycled bed as they race to finish their top-floor apartment.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Ben and Billie battle brambles to create a riverside retreat. Louisa and Roger race to finish a new suite at Château de Montespieu with a few last-minute design changes. At Château Méaume near Bordeaux, Mark and Sandra scramble to ready their gîte for its very first guests - but with lighting unfinished and upcycling projects still under way, there's still plenty to do.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Jon and Carmen start work on their deluxe vineyard pergola, but Jon's measurements go awry. Sarah and George scramble to transform a neglected pigeon house covered in droppings into a wedding focal point.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Vivienne and Simon attempt to transform a peeling, lifeless room into their deluxe Empire Suite, with beds to upcycle, giant mirrors to install and the entire space to re-invent.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Donna and Paul race to waterproof their basement of their once-derelict five-floor home as river levels rise in Brittany. Eleanor and Ben explore different châteaux near the Pyrenees that they hope will lead them to a forever family home. Vivienne and Simon plan a lavish costume party themed around their new Empire Suite.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Alicia and Carlton are getting Château D'Aran wedding-ready, but with the ceremony approaching fast and a bathroom still to revamp, the pressure's mounting. Eleanor and Ben continue their dream château hunt near the Pyrenees, while Kathryn and Steve try to squeeze a modern bathroom into a former coal store.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: In Brittany, Donna and Paul return to the basement of their five-storey home, and the race is on to install the final windows and seal the rear façade before the elements take over. At Château de la Grillère, Tim and Sharon are desperate to open their doors to guests, but with a first-floor suite unfinished, a window seat to build and wasps in the chimney, everything is against them.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Jon and Carmen prepare a bespoke wedding aisle for their big day and, with a baby on the way, Anna and Maxime begin renovating their new family château.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: At Château La Grande Maison, Ben and Billie dream of transforming their tired orangerie into a serene health spa, while Chris and Jolyon tackle the final two of their eight bedrooms, taking on intricate wallpaper, a handmade bunk bed and a secret bookcase door.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Nick and Nicole are desperate to transform the front of their Dordogne home from a chaotic building site into an architectural showpiece. Tim and Krys prepare for their first dog show at Château Domaine de la Barde, juggling DIY projects that promise to get tongues and tails wagging.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Donna and Paul plan to install a rear balcony at their chateau in Brittany, but it's a demanding job that requires Paul to handle heavy steel girders and cut through decades-old reinforced concrete. Renovations are also under way at Châteaux de la Vergne and de la Grillère, while a wedding party are trapped by dangerous trees near Cognac.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Jane and Rory's handmade kitchen island won't fit through the gîte door at Château de Pican. Bart and Sarah rush to prepare their Cognac barn for their best friend's wedding, and at Château de la Vergne, Lionel and Claire work on the gilded ceiling for their dining room and bespoke fromage cupboard.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Donna and Paul need a winch to complete their huge balcony installation in Brittany. Jane and Rory have a smashing time in their gîte kitchen at Château de Pican, and near Cognac, Sarah and George use their antiques expertise for another wedding.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: In the Charente, Sophie and Ray begin transforming a tower room into a bridal suite. But the space currently looks like a 1970s sauna and there are bird droppings in the ceiling. In Brittany, Donna and Paul face a balcony crisis and are forced to winch oversized flooring up the outside of their home.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: In the Charente, Sophie and Ray struggle to bring the modern to the ancient. At Château Domaine de la Barde, a laundry room renovation has Krys and Tim in a spin. And at Château de Cézérac, Jon and Carmen encounter problems with their potager.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Half-built walls and a ticking clock haunt Sophie and Ray at Château des Fouilloux. A massive water leak forces Stephanie into a full kitchen rebuild at Château de Lalande. And in Occitania, happily ever after seems a long way off for Janet and Philip.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: After a major flood at Château de Lalande, Stephanie needs to complete a full kitchen refurb before a house full of guests descend for her 50th birthday extravaganza. Near Cognac, Bart and Sarah rush to complete a bathroom for their best friends' wedding. Near the Pyrenees, sustainability champion Trish rescues battery hens and plans to build them a château of their own, complete with roosting rooms.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: In Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Christina and Sassan want to create a deluxe apartment, but they're starting with a tired-looking guest room. They're gambling on bold wallpaper, bespoke woodwork and an upcycled door to create the mega transformation. In the Dordogne, dirty laundry is piling up at Château Domaine de la Barde while Tim and Krys complete vital plumbing and cabinetry for their colossal launderette. Near Cognac, it's finally wedding day at Bart and Sarah's, but thunderstorms are looming.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Erin and JB go underground to tackle a major electrical fault at Château de Bourneau, while at Château Domaine de la Barde, Tim wants to build a vast new terrace, which means rebuilding a centuries-old wall and clearing a bamboo forest. in the Dordogne, Jon and Carmen's 300-year-old kitchen floor needs lifting and is only coming up in pieces.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: At Château de la Boutinière, Alison and Zion have just weeks left to complete a three-year wedding garden makeover before the first bridal party arrive. Tim and Krys get stuck with eight tons of quick-drying concrete. Tim and Sasha upgrade their chicken coop.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: At Château de Montespieu, Louisa and Roger want to create a stunning new suite before a wedding, but a secret tower room and a locked safe could spell trouble. At Château de la Ruche, Tim and Rebecca want to transform a tired, neglected outbuilding into a potting shed in preparation for Rebecca's first ever flower retreat.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: At Château de Montespieu, Louisa and Roger continue work on their Gingko Suite, but a shocking bathroom discovery could change everything. Debbie and Dave's craft room is derailed, while Donna and Paul are pushed to their limits after struggling to haul a standalone roll-top bath up three floors.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Jane and Rory dive into a new project and Anna and Maxime tame a wild, overgrown courtyard. Louisa and Rodger face the challenge of finishing a new suite before a wedding party arrives - knowing if they fail, they'll have a very unhappy bride on their hands.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Vivienne and Simon at Château de la Croix Boisée attempt their grandest bedroom yet, hand-painting panels, adding bold architectural details and rewiring lights. In the Dordogne, Nick and Nicole take a huge risk building a concrete arch, and at Château de Pican, near the Pyrenees, Jane and Rory race to finish a luxury pool.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: May and Guy tackle their monumental list of projects at Château de la Vigne. Vivienne and Simon race to complete their Bridgerton-inspired master bedroom at Château de la Croix Boisée. At Château de Lalacelle, Terry and Ashley revamp their chateau's front garden before an open day.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Donna and Paul take their house apart to replace the very beams that hold the building up. Anna and Max race to finish a courtyard before family descend for a celebratory meal and Terry and Ashley hope their garden will be complete in time for the arrival of 1,000 visitors.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Jon and Carmen hope to finally get married after years of colossal DIY challenges. Terry and Ashley try to bring their opulent vision to life, and Christina and Sassan scramble to finish their guest apartment.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: At Château de la Boutinière, after five years of hard work, this once-abandoned and graffiti-covered shell prepares to host its biggest ever wedding. But with just days to go, Alison and Zion race to get every final detail right. In the Loire Valley, at Château de la Croix Boisée, Vivienne and Simon strike up the overture for a retirement party worthy of Vivienne's opera-singing mother, but their terrace is still far from centre stage. And in Normandy, Xavier and Tasha finally get the keys to their dream home.
